question: The official mascot of the Commonwealth Games 2022 was _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Perry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The official mascot for the Commonwealth Games 2022 is **Perry**.
 
• **Perry** is a multi-coloured bull, symbolizing strength, unity, and diversity.
 
• The mascot was designed to represent the cultural heritage and spirit of Birmingham, the host city.
 
• Perry was chosen after a nationwide competition in the UK, involving hundreds of schoolchildren.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games**:

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is a multi-sport event held every four years, involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada.
 
• It includes various sports such as athletics, swimming, and cycling, among others.
 
 
 
• **Previous Mascots**:
 
 
• The 2018 Commonwealth Games mascot was Borobi, a blue koala representing the Gold Coast, Australia.
 
• The 2014 Games in Glasgow had Clyde, a thistle-inspired character.
 
 
 
• **Birmingham 2022**:
 
 
• Birmingham was announced as the host city for the 2022 Commonwealth Games in December 2017.
 
• The event will feature 19 sports and 8 para-sports.
 
• It is expected to significantly boost the local economy and promote tourism.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Mascots**:
 
 
• Mascots play a crucial role in promoting the event and engaging the public.
 
• They often embody the cultural and social values of the host city.
